C0807.title: 175 Malicious npm Packages Leverage CDN to Conceal Phishing Attacks
C0807.summary: In November 2025, attackers published at least 175 malicious packages on the npm public registry, accumulating over 26,000 downloads. These packages used CDN infrastructure to hide malicious behavior and carried out targeted phishing campaigns, posing a serious threat to downstream users.
